source_text: Elders' insistence on tradition contrasts with evidence that communities historically abandon injurious customs through internal reckoning, as seen in declining voluntary cessation rates predating formal bans in select Nigerian locales, prioritizing causal evidence of suffering over unsubstantiated cultural imperatives. [19]
